WITH feb_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 2
),
num AS (
  SELECT SUM(r.sr_return_amt) AS return_amt
  FROM feb_sales s
  JOIN store_returns r
    ON r.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number

),
